g.text: A stepped shaft transfers gear forces to bearings while carrying torque

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned simple supports1 m apart, transverse gear forces Ft2 kN and Fr=Ft tan20°≈.728 kN in orthogonal planes. Torque enters from the left and leaves
through the gear. Maximum resultant bending occurs at the gear; the critical stress section may instead be a smaller shoulder because diameter and
concentration matter. No shaft diameter is selected.
